features.text: TARGETED CMC SUPPORT: Stabilizes the thumb base joint without restricting hand movement.
ARTHRITIS RELIEF: Reduces pain and inflammation caused by osteoarthritis or overuse.
WATERPROOF, DURABLE BUILD: Molded latex-free plastic offers long-lasting, easy-clean use.
ADJUSTABLE STRAP SYSTEM: Ensures a custom, comfortable fit around the thumb and wrist.
FULL HAND FUNCTION PRESERVED: Allows normal grip strength while supporting the CMC joint.
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.
PERFECT FIT PROMISE: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with our U.S.-based specialists.

indications: CMC osteoarthritis and thumb base pain
Soft tissue irritation, thumb sprains, and overuse injuries
